title: 百人分の盾になれ
reward: 統率者の護陣と町の生還

scenes.name: 人形にしない
scenes.purpose: 強い主人公が斬らない理由を示す

panels.art: Possessed adult guards surge down town street with spears, black wrist bands and blank eyes. Yun steps BETWEEN them and civilians; sword sheathed. So Rin leads mother away left, Hakujin blocks side street with an empty palm.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun gently catches spear SHAFT, bends it aside without harming carrier. Sees cracked black band on guard wrist, alarmed compassionate face.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: So Rin holds door of stone warehouse open, beckoning townspeople inside; practical leadership, no hammer combat.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Hakujin uses a slate-blue cloak to catch falling lantern before it ignites market cloth, RIGHT wrist clean, focused.
panels.speaker: 白燼

scenes.transitionNarration: 夜が明けても、命令は止まらない。

scenes.name: 百人の力
scenes.purpose: 第5話の称号を救助へ回収する

panels.art: Yun recalls bronze disk at sash and crowd from arena, checks tiny CYAN hologram reading exactly: 百人の統率者 / 護陣　使用可能. Sword now drawn RIGHT hand pointing down, left palm open.
panels.speaker: システム
panels.text: 百人の統率者　護陣　使用可能

panels.art: Former spear champion from episode 5 approaches along with adult contest losers, weapons lowered, eager determined. Yun amazed; none kneel.
panels.speaker: 槍の王

panels.art: Yun touches sword TIP gently to ground, huge cyan protective arcs rise UP over town, connected to open hands of allies, one sword only, no blasts hitting bodies.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 力を貸して。守るために。

panels.art: Large borderless view of protective dome over market. BLACK wrist seals on guards dissolve into dust while shields catch falling debris. Town intact; civilians inside visibly safe. No mass bodies or death.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

scenes.name: 救ったあとの手
scenes.purpose: 生還への反応を先に置いてから門へ進む

panels.art: Released guard blinks, drops spear safely to ground, sits with knees trembling, mother reaches to help him. Yun kneels checking breathing.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close Yun hands shake a little after rescue, smith offers warm cup, white-haired ally relaxed. Dawn edge no new enemies.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
panels.text: 助けたんだよ。ちゃんと。

panels.art: Yun breathes and holds cup both hands, small genuine smile of relief. Sword sheathed at left hip.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Bronze gate disk in Yun's LEFT palm glows CYAN toward distant mountain path. Small translucent hologram exactly: 帰還門　起動. He looks toward mountains, hopeful.
panels.speaker: システム

scenes.name: 守る場所を決める
scenes.purpose: 退避を続けながら一人で防げない範囲を確かめ、仲間に頼る理由を作る

panels.art: Town evacuation continues. Yun with sword SHEATHED looks between two streets where marked living soldiers approach. No protective dome yet. Civilians moving toward safe alley.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 両方には、手が届かない。

panels.art: So Rin signals civilians toward the forge's side alley, checks the last child is beside their parent. Practical, no victims newly invented.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Hakujin with CLEAN right wrist stands at a side junction, OPEN palms stopping people from running into danger, not attacking marked soldiers. Yun sees him.
panels.speaker: 白燼

panels.art: Close Yun opens his tense empty hands, takes a breath and looks toward approaching allies off-frame. His one sword remains SHEATHED, no hologram or shield yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 一人で、抱えなくていい。
